profile.name: DG1000Z函数/任意波形发生器
profile.description: 这是一台台式函数/任意波形发生器，用于输出正弦波、脉冲、直流和任意波形等电信号，并支持突发输出等模式。它常用于电子学实验、仪器联调、电路激励、时序与脉冲测试以及传感器或控制系统的信号模拟。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop function/arbitrary waveform generator used to produce electrical test signals such as standard waveforms, pulses, DC levels, and arbitrary waveforms, with support for burst output modes. It is commonly used in electronics labs for circuit stimulation, instrument testing, timing and pulse experiments, and signal emulation for sensors or control systems.

registry.description: RIGOL DG1000Z Series Function Generator是由RIGOL Technologies生产的表征设备，主要功能包括使能、电压设置、触发。
